text:
Mia: Quick design ask — we need a small set of micro-benchmark visuals for the mini launch/demo flow next Wed. Focus: latency vs cost, 3 model tiers (hosted, dedicated, private), and one 'what to expect' flow diagram for demos.
Alex: Nice — can you list the exact deliverables + sizes?
Mia: Sure: 1) hero infographic (1200x628) for social & blog; 2) 3 small cards (800x800) for product pages showing cost/latency tradeoffs; 3) a one-slide flow diagram (1920x1080) for demos; 4) a condensed GIF for emails (600x400, ~3s). Export: PNG high-res + SVG for diagrams + GIF for email.
Sam: Routing Q — for the demo slide CTA, do we route leads to hosted trial or a demo signup? need to set UTM.
Nina: Demo CTA should point to the hosted trial for PLG motion, but include an enterprise path in small type. UTM: ?utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic
Mia: Design constraints: follow brand guardrails, 60% primary palette, use the new icon set for model tiers (we have svg icons in /assets/icons). Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text overlays. Also make a version with alt-text-ready labels.
Alex: Copy for cards: short headline + one-line stat. examples: '2–8x throughput, 25% lower token cost' or 'sub-50ms p95 latency on small inputs'. I can draft exact copy by EOD.
Mia: Great — please add copy here when ready. Also need variants: english + fr (small translation for landing).
Sam: For inbound routing — when someone clicks the hero, mark as MQL if they hit the trial and spend >5m or create API key. Backend will tag with source=mini_launch.
Mia: Timeline: draft assets by Mon 9am PT, first review Mon afternoon, final by Tue noon so growth can schedule posts. Is that doable?
Alex: Draft copy tonight, will drop into this thread.
nina: Can design reuse the benchmark sparkline from last quarter? smaller, but matching color scheme?
Mia: Yes reuse OK but edit palette to match new primary. I'll pull the file. BenchBot: asset-check /icons/bench-sparkline.svg exists?
BenchBot: asset-check: /assets/icons/bench-sparkline.svg found, last modified 1998801234.
Mia: Perfect. Also request a slide template (one master slide + 2 content variants) so PMs can swap in numbers for demos. Include notes panel text for speaker cues.
Sam: Need a small form asset — 1-line signup component (PNG + HTML snippet) that can be embedded in doc pages; can we include `data-utm` attributes?
Mia: Yes include `data-utm="mini_launch"` in the snippet. For HTML snippet keep inline styles minimal.
Alex: Copy drop: Card A headline: 'Inference that scales.' Stat: 'Up to 4x throughput on open models' Card B headline: 'Predictable costs' Stat: 'Save ~20% per token' Hero CTA: 'Try the hosted API'
Mia: Thanks — will mock with that. Accessibility reminder: keep button contrast >4.5. Also prioritize alt text and SVG title tags for diagrams.
Nina: Localization: I'll get French copy by Mon noon. Sam: confirm routing to SFDC campaign 'Mini Launch Q2'.
Sam: Confirmed — will create campaign and map leads. Also will attach default lead owner rules.
Mia: One more ask: include a 'limitations' microcard (tiny) that notes model variability and suggested eval checklist link. Link text: https://redwood.example.com/evals-checklist
Alex: Ack — will include short 12-word blurb.
Mia: Closing checklist for handoff: 1) PNG/SVG/GIF exports; 2) slide template with notes; 3) HTML snippet with UTM; 4) french variants; 5) accessibility alt/text doc; 6) deliverable zip + CDN-ready filenames.
Nina: All set on PM side. If design hits blockers, ping me.
Mia: I'll post initial mocks by Mon 9am and @channel call for review. :memo:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :white_check_mark:
